speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma-COPD Overlap (ACO). The combination of a subacute cough, significant smoking history, and spirometry showing both obstruction and reversibility is characteristic of this condition. Given the eight-week duration and current symptoms, I recommend a trial of inhaled corticosteroids combined with a long-acting bronchodilator to see if your symptoms improve.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Acute exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
